New and edited content is translated aut: New and edited content is translated automatically. Only you publish reviewed drafts.
Existing published translations stay unc: Existing published translations stay unchanged while drafts are prepared.
The latest 1000 jobs are shown. Filter b: The latest 1000 jobs are shown. Filter by language, content or status.
Lock manually reviewed translations to p: Lock manually reviewed translations to prevent automatic work and publication. Up to 100 matching targets are shown.
Interface keys are checked separately fr: Interface keys are checked separately from lesson translations. New interface features must include all language keys before deployment.
Dynamic keys and text without translatio: Dynamic keys and text without translation markers need developer review.
Check every translated field before publ: Check every translated field before publishing. Editing and saving a draft does not publish it.
RECONCILE_REQUIRED: An uncertain API request needs administrator reconciliation before retrying.
BUDGET_LIMIT: The shared budget limit has been reached. This job is waiting.
BUDGET_UNAVAILABLE: The shared budget record is unavailable. No API request will be sent.
SHARED_BUDGET_BUSY: Another translation job is using the shared budget. This job will wait.
CONFIG_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The private translation configuration needs administrator review.
MISSING_SOURCE_TITLE: Add a source title before translating.
VALIDATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Translation checks did not pass. Review this job before retrying.
TRANSLATION_LOCKED: This translation is locked. Unlock it before publishing.
SOURCE_CHANGED: The source changed. Review the latest draft instead.
TRANSLATION_CHANGED: The existing translation was edited. It has been preserved; review the conflict.
SOURCE_INACTIVE: This source is archived or inactive.
RETRY_NOT_ALLOWED: This job cannot be retried in its current state.
DRAFT_NOT_READY: This draft is not ready for publication.
PROTECTED_VALUES_CHANGED: Numbers, links or placeholders changed. Restore the source values.
FRAGMENT_COUNT_MISMATCH: The translated fields do not match the source structure.
HTML_STRUCTURE_CHANGED: The HTML structure changed. Preserve the source tags and attributes.
INVALID_DRAFT_SHAPE: The draft fields do not match the required format.
OPERATION_FAILED: The operation could not be completed. Reload and try again.
